content:
Tess (PM): quick poke  can we prototype a compact per-route+model "cohort" preview in Console? goal: let SREs / PMs quickly see cost/latency by pinned combos without opening full route inspector. thoughts on shape?
Ravi - Eng: love it. API options: 1) extend "saved_query" to include "cohorts" array, 2) new "saved_cohort" resource. prefer new resource so lifecycle is clearer.
June - Design: compact card = name + chips for route/model + three metrics (qps, p95 latency, est daily tokens). small sparkline optional. click expands. keep copy minimal.
Tess (PM): agree on new resource. need telemetry fidelity notes: sampled data may mislead for low-traffic combos.
Marco - Data: correct. telemetry sampling is by route. model routing decisions stored in separate logs. we can produce a daily aggregated table keyed by (route_id, model_id) that approximates counts & latencies using sample-weighting. add a "sampled=true" badge when sample_rate < 1.
Owens - Platform: cost calc must use billing rates and current quantization config. also a caveat: some routes have runtime fallbacks (e.g., prefer v2 but occasionally call v1). preview should include a "routing_mix" column showing % traffic to each model if available.
Eve - Security: saved cohorts can include filters referencing customer ids. must default to team-scoped visibility and sanitize examples in UI. audit log every cohort create/update.
Ravi - Eng: API sketch: 
```json
{
  "id":"co_4139",
  "name":"heavy-search-cohort",
  "owner_team":"search-platform",
  "pins":[{"route_id":"r_search","model_id":"m_bloom_v2","filters":[{"field":"status","op":"=","value":"200"}]}],
  "visibility":"team",
  "preview_opts":{"include_sparkline":true,"assume_worst_case":false}
}
```
June - Design: UI toggle for "assume worst-case" should show what changes (tokens++). also want a subtle tooltip: "estimates from sampled telemetry and routing logs".
Marco - Data: for low traffic pins we'll return a CI like "±30%" and include sample_rate numeric. we can compute Wilson score for ratios and bootstrap for avg latency. will add columns: sample_rate, ci_low, ci_high.
Owens - Platform: implementation plan: daily job that joins sampled traces with model-routing decisions and writes aggregates to analytics_store. Console reads aggregates for compact previews. For on-demand detailed queries we can hit the join pipeline but rate-limit.
Tess (PM): rollout plan: feature-flag + gated to enterprise orgs with >1k daily tokens initially. add telemetry opt-out for sensitive teams.
Eve - Security: confirm export of cohort previews is disabled by default. any CSV/Share actions require permission.
Ravi - Eng: one practical note: we should store only references in DB (route/model/filter refs) to avoid snapshot drift; add a background validator that marks stale pins (model deleted / route removed).
June - Design: microcopy for stale pin: "Model removed — preview unavailable" with CTA to edit.
deploy-bot: FF created: "cohort_compact_preview" enabled=false. Scheduled roll: 2026-06-01T08:00:00Z
Tess (PM): next actions: Ravi + Marco file API + data tickets, June to mock card variants, Owens to estimate infra cost. I'll collate and schedule a 30m sync.
